scope: Normative future implementation outcomes; these scenarios are not executed against a database by Workspace conformance. Canonical JSONL fixtures use Harness trusted-config.json. Symbolic failure injections require a consumer adapter.

setup.isolation: Same child is valid against the candidate history before summary; rejection must be due to frozen producer run.
Stored B duplicates A. Incoming A duplicates B in a new unfinalized run; valid next sequence and identity, but historical union closes a cycle.

fixtureNotation: Before sending, recursively expand recordRef by event_id from the pinned canonicalFixtures JSONL files. Expand {repeat:<record>,count:N} to an array of N copies. These are fixture directives, never wire fields. setup is test-harness state/injection, never request input. For concurrent execution, compare expected.statusMultiset against the sorted multiset of actual responses; either winner ordering is valid.
